note: Score a point for every right guess. Swap who guesses each spin.

prompts.text: What would I order at a new restaurant?
My dream holiday, in one place?
What do I secretly find hardest about mornings?
Which friend would I call in a crisis?
What would I do with a free Saturday?
Which chore do I hate most?
What smell takes me back to childhood?
What would I rescue first in a fire (people and pets are safe)?
Where would I live if money was no object?
What am I most proud of this year?
